text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr had never shown interest in 
others before. Yet here she is, eyes glued 
to the TV screen. What caught her 
attention is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is a show featuring Tokai Teio. Her 
goal is to become an "undefeated Triple 
Crown Umamusume," just like the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she says her dream lies even 
further ahead. That dream is— to surpass 
the "Emperor" and become the "Emperor of 
Emperors."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Never having even considered "surpassing" 
the admired Emperor of the Mile, Yamanin 
Zephyr was left in absolute shock.
